faq.q: Do buyers pay an agency fee?
faq.a: No. In this test agency the seller pays the agency fee.

faq.q: Can you arrange viewings by video call?
faq.a: Yes. An agent can show any available property by video call.

faq.q: Which languages does the team speak?
faq.a: English, Spanish and Swedish in the office. The assistant answers in German, Dutch and French too.
Avenida de la Prueba 1, Marbella. Free parking in front.

faq.q: Do you help with NIE numbers, lawyers or mortgages?
faq.a: An agent can introduce you to independent lawyers and mortgage brokers. The assistant does not give legal, tax or mortgage advice.
